evidence: src/infrastructure/error-middleware.ts: errorMiddleware(err, _req, res, _next) is an Express error handler, which is transport/framework logic suited to the infrastructure layer.
The instanceof checks for ValidationError, NotFoundError and ConflictError set HTTP statuses 400, 404 and 409, translating domain errors into transport responses.
The fallback res.status(500).json({ error: "internal server error" }) handles generic transport errors and contains no business decision.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is an Express error-handling middleware. Its only job is to turn domain error types into HTTP status codes and JSON responses, which is transport/framework adaptation and belongs in the infrastructure layer. It has no business rules (it only checks the error type and passes the message through), no persistence and no application orchestration. Import direction is out of scope.
